info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Transaction Management API
info.description: The Transaction Management API enables businesses to execute and manage financial transactions seamlessly. This API provides functionalities for initiating transactions related to account management, ensuring secure and efficient processing. Typical consumers include financial institutions, payment processors, and developers looking to integrate transaction capabilities into their applications. Use cases may involve transferring funds, processing payments, or handling transaction confirmations.

post.summary: Creates a new transaction in the account management system.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new transaction within the account management system. Ensure that all necessary details are provided in the request body to successfully initiate the transaction.
